refresh_only_stale_widgets_after_resume.recommended_default_reason: Refresh expired data after wake without replaying every missed task.

replay_missed_scheduled_runs_after_resum.recommended_default_reason: Avoid a task stampede after a long sleep period.

pause_network_heavy_widgets_when_locked.recommended_default_reason: Reduce background traffic while the desktop session is locked.

pause_low_priority_widgets_on_battery.recommended_default_reason: Preserve battery life without disabling essential Widgets.

refresh_time_widgets_after_time_zone_cha.recommended_default_reason: Keep clocks and market-session Widgets correct after travel.

network_recovery_debounce_seconds.recommended_default_reason: Prevent duplicate refresh waves during unstable reconnects.

resource_sample_interval_seconds.recommended_default_reason: Collect a useful baseline without continuous high-frequency polling.

idle_cpu_warning_percent.recommended_default_reason: Freeze the warning threshold only after measuring the Proof-of-Concept baseline.

idle_working_set_warning_bytes.recommended_default_reason: Freeze the memory threshold only after measuring the Proof-of-Concept baseline.
